purpose: Reference a quiet minimal paper-zine prompt grammar, quantitative negative-space composition, variation recipes, thumbnail review, and one-retry color-anchor correction for NERO-native cover and chapter visuals.
style: aged paper, 70%-90% negative space, one compact subject cluster, sparse serif or typewriter composition, one high-chroma anchor, xerox/risograph/halftone defects

exact text, figures, labels, logos, or source notes would be accepted from the raster generation layer
copying upstream example JPEGs into public or client deliverables
installing the upstream Skill as a parallel NDT entrypoint

notes: Use the NERO-native minimal-zine-editorial rule, preset, overlay template, and QA gate. The snapshot is attribution and reference metadata only.
readme_summary: GC Minimal Zine Poster is a single Codex SKILL.md plus six generated JPEG examples. It compiles themes or briefs into sparse 3:5 paper posters using quantitative negative space, a small subject cluster, sparse typography, one high-chroma anchor, print defects, a variation engine, thumbnail inspection, and at most one corrective regeneration. It has no editable PSD, Figma, SVG, HTML, PPTX, component library, dependency runtime, or automated QA system.
key_patterns: strong negative constraints against commercial and glossy layouts
